correctness.rationale: A reproducible finite proof enumerates all 130 faults by eight orbits, all simplicial faces in each orbit, every matched Hasse arrow and proves no directed cycles. It exactly computes signed integer cellular differential from 4 to 3 as the zero matrix; only one 0-cell plus critical 3-,4-cells remain, and Hurewicz shows zero degree means nullhomotopic attaching maps. Original-chain mod-two Betti checks independently agree. All eight certificates replayed successfully.

originality.rationale: Full claim-to-prior comparisons identify intact K3,3 Morse homotopy as known; its published proof and theorem exclude faults. The published connectivity, collapsibility, star-cluster and related biclique results do not imply the seven new edge-fault homotopy types, particularly the first contractible three-edge path fault. Both actual published-finding corpus semantic searches and the 93 own prior claims were inspected for overlaps. Non-indexed duplicates remain a risk; lack of a hit alone is not treated as proof.
residual_risks: Search indices are incomplete and a mathematically equivalent unindexed exact computation may exist.
Some secondary papers were compared using indexed statements rather than every possible appendix; neither is evidence of exhaustive world-wide novelty.

value.rationale: The complete lowest-fault orbit classification of the natural complete biclique Morse complex finds the first contractible fault only at deletion of a three-edge path, while star, matching and disconnected faults have distinct homotopy signatures. Distinguishing mixed-degree spheres after one fault is not a known connectivity or Euler characteristic deduction; exact homotopy types are suitable boundary cases for larger-graph fault questions.
